input.quote: 14.2 Upon creation and subject to payment of the applicable Fees, Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for Customer. Vendor hereby assigns to Customer all worldwide right, title, and interest in those Deliverables and shall obtain equivalent assignments from its personnel.
input.rationale: The IP package meets our preferred position. Section 14.1 confirms Customer owns Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information and independently developed IP, with no transfer to Vendor beyond a limited processing right; 14.2 gives Customer ownership of Deliverables with an express Vendor assignment and personnel assignments; 14.3 lets Vendor retain Vendor Technology but pulls in the Section 13.2 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence (including modify, create derivative works and contractor support) for embedded Vendor Technology; and 14.4 bars joint ownership absent a signed instrument and limits feedback use to generalized suggestions while Customer keeps unrestricted rights in its feedback. Section 15.1 further prevents sale, advertising use, cross-customer combination or model training on Customer Data, and the Customer Data definition captures derived output while carving out only unlinkable telemetry. No assignment of Customer IP or data to Vendor and no unrestricted joint ownership, so nothing to redline.
